description: UC Santa Cruz + China intl with highSchoolLocation set + strong RD (regression: original 4/26 prod returned 19% due to geo+intl double-penalty)
rationale: UCSC anchor 0.47. Pre-PR-8: intl 0.4 × geo OOS 0.5 (CN ≠ CA at strong-pref public) × strong stats ~1.95 = 0.39 → 47% × 0.39 = 18.3% (matches the actual prod 19% screenshot). Post-PR-8: intl 0.95 (less-selective, >40%) × geo SKIPPED (intl) × strong stats 1.95 = 1.85 → 47% × 1.85 = 0.87 capped at 47% × 2.5 = 1.18 → result ~0.87. Range [0.65, 0.95] catches both bugs: too low (geo not skipped) AND too high (>cap). This case must use highSchoolLocation: 'CN' to specifically trigger the bug path.
